risk_summary: The disclosure is quantitatively detailed and reports revenue and earnings growth, but highlights material operational vulnerabilities, including biological production variability, equipment failure, contamination, water availability, energy costs, and competitive pricing pressure. Customer concentration and reliance on future taxable income are disclosed, while several forward-looking risks remain subject to uncertainty and management estimates.
